metadata.description: A plugin marketplace for agentic coding tools from Adam Caviness

plugins.name: agentic-toolkit
plugins.description: Skills for ticket triage (bugs, architecture, product), code review, and branch shipping

plugins.name: agentic-atlas
plugins.description: Profile agentic development approaches on 13 signed, diverging axes; deterministic engine, no API key.

plugins.name: prompt-marks
plugins.description: Claude Code mod: marks your prompts in the transcript and jumps between them with Option or Ctrl plus Up and Down.

plugins.name: cache-magic
plugins.description: Claude Code mod: writes a handoff while a large idle session's prompt cache is still warm, then sends a prompt that arrives after it expired with the handoff instead of the full context.
